title: TableRoll
description:
The outcome of rolling on a `Table`.

A roll records what was rolled and what it produced: the `formula`, the `result`, and one
`TableRollDetail` per cell of the matched row. Rolls nest — a detail whose cell referenced
another table carries that table's own rolls — so a single roll can be a tree several levels
deep, which is what the rendering methods here flatten into indented text.

Unlike the other table types this is a plain `Codable` value, not a Realm object. It is
serialized into `Table/rolls` for history, into `Message/content` for the chat log, and
sent to the web client.

- SeeAlso: `Table`, `TableRollDetail`, `Message`

id.description:
The unique identifier for this roll.

A UUID string generated when the roll is created, used to identify it in lists and in the
chat log.

name.description:
The name of the table that was rolled on.

## Examples
- `"Magic Item Table A"`

formula.description:
The dice expression that was rolled.

## Examples
- `"d100"`
- `"Multiple rolls"` — produced by `Table/RollMode/eachRow`, which rolls no dice

result.description:
The rolled result that selected the row.

For tables matched by position this is the one-based row number. In
`Table/RollMode/noRepeat` it may be the row's own value rather than the number actually
rolled, when the rolled row was already taken.

details.description:
The content of the matched row, one entry per cell.

The range column is excluded, since it holds the lookup key rather than content.

- SeeAlso: `TableRollDetail`

reference.description:
A link back to the table this roll came from.

Makes the table name tappable in the chat log and lets `reroll()` find the table again.

## Examples
- `"/table/6195ae04-cc85-526b-8456-56d0ab36adc2"`
